t.title: Kelvin Custódio — Full Stack Developer | PHP, Laravel, Vue.js
t.description: Kelvin Custódio's portfolio, full stack developer based in Jericó, Brazil. Web applications built with PHP, Laravel, Vue.js, TypeScript, MySQL and Docker.

sidebar.text: Full stack developer based in Jericó, Brazil. I build web applications end to end — from database to interface — using PHP, Laravel, Vue.js and Docker.

about.title: About Me
about.description: I'm a full stack developer and I follow projects from conception through maintenance and continuous evolution. I have strong command of PHP, JavaScript, Laravel, Vue.js, Docker and MySQL, always applying good software architecture practices, automated testing and CI/CD.

services.title: What I build
services.description: I work on every layer of a web application: APIs and business logic in PHP and Laravel, interface in Vue.js and TypeScript, database in MySQL and infrastructure with Docker, Nginx and continuous delivery pipelines.
